name: Lighthold: Keep the Light
summary: Every night, shadows crawl out of the sea and head straight for the last lighthouse. Aim a powerful light beam to burn away swarms, walkers, fog clouds and underground diggers, shake the ground to expose hidden enemies and call down lightning in emergencies. Between nights, spend Lumen on upgrade trees for the Lighthouse, Clock Tower, Dock, Hut and treasure chest, and adopt companions: a small monster with a fishing lure, a dog with a lantern and an owl. When the Dock is ready, sail away: the run resets, but Starlight upgrades are permanent. A cozy, low-poly tower defense roguelite with short nights and relaxed days.
